title: Catalog-bound caller-run source-part transformation into exact target-DDL-bound detached Wide output

claim.root_adversary: ROBUST within the bounded caller-run one-source-part transform target
claim.global_goal: ACTIVE; full types/MV/projections frontier remains open; memory/performance deferred
claim.meaning: Curated index to executed root commands and source/capture pins. Structural validity, hashes and correlated model agreement are not substantive behavioral proof.

risk.boundary: Public callback scan lifecycle, offline catalog identity and persistent detached publication
risk.rollback: One exact-path local atomic feature commit over the recorded baseline. No push, dependency change or history rewrite.
risk.strongest_failure: Publishing a valid part into the wrong target or after an incomplete, reentrant or failed source scan.
risk.guard: One-shot poisoned scan protocol, exact ordered prepared-owner target binding, identity refresh and exclusive stage/publication.

api: OfflineCatalog#transform_materialized_view_part(database, view_name, source_part_name, source_columns, output_part_name, ...) { |input| WidePartTransformOutput.new(keys, columns) }
laws: Complete source inventory with exactly one direct reference; UUID-aware named/inner MV target resolution is reused.
Selected part belongs to the globally resolved candidate set and passes existing typed DDL/physical preflight. Selected ALIAS columns and virtual paths with ALIAS parents are refused.
One callback-scoped scan must return normally after exact row_count accounting. No scan, early break even after all rows, a second scan, reentry and swallowed scan failures poison completion.
Input handle is invalidated on success and failure before identity refresh/owner preparation. Post-success retained-handle misuse refuses without deleting an already published part.
Nonempty caller-sorted UInt64 keys and existing static BinaryBulk, Dynamic, Object and recursive owners supply output. Keys/container rosters are detached copies; batches remain borrowed.
Ordered target names and exact declarations bind the already-prepared owners before metadata/encoding/staging. Owners prepare once under the existing shared budgets.
Ordinary unpartitioned MergeTree target; first single ascending UInt64 ORDER key, optional matching PRIMARY key, no modifiers or projections.
Only matching index_granularity (omitted means 8192) and paired zero Wide thresholds or both omitted are admitted target SETTINGS. Unknown clauses/settings and duplicates refuse.
Destination is a canonical all_* basename under the resolved target's plain existing detached directory; occupied/overlapping target candidates refuse.
Before publication re-resolve exact DDL/UUIDs/source candidate path, identity/count/layout and target/destination identity. Existing writer stages, reads back and exclusively publishes.

fixture.transformation: Filter pk>=3; add 100 to keys and 1000 to scalar/numeric Dynamic values; append ! to string Dynamic/document labels; add 10 to document tags; transform recursive children.
fixture.strings_and_children: NULL, empty/ragged children, NUL and UTF-8
fixture.physical_profile: Wide/LZ4/Default/plain mrk2/plain primary; ordinary with_size_stream; shared single_stream; BASIC discriminator; 32-byte frames
fixture.object_scope: Typed-only Object documents, not inferred shared-data Object layouts
fixture.independence: Stock source INSERT precedes MV creation and the target is empty. The persisted identity SELECT with WHERE pk>=3 is intentionally not claimed equivalent to caller callback output.

local_refusals: Incomplete/ambiguous source inventory, unknown or overlapping selected candidate, selected ALIAS or ALIAS-parent virtual path
Nonordinary/partitioned/modified/projected target, unknown or duplicate layout settings, general keys and mismatching key/granularity
Missing/incomplete/reentrant/repeated/failed source scan and swallowed protocol violations
Empty output, unsorted keys and output roster/name/declaration mismatch
Changed compared DDL/UUID/source candidate identity/count/layout/target path, occupied destination or target overlap
Unadmitted type/layout products, unsupported AggregateFunction leaves and Nullable(Dynamic) controls remain refused
non_guarantees: SQL SELECT parsing/evaluation, joins/functions, SELECT equivalence or callback provenance
MV triggers, freshness, automatic backfill, dependency completeness or server Active-state proof
General key/partition derivation, transform-produced projection children or composable bounded output appenders
Every type/layout/state product, Compact top-level part writing, all nested profiles/versions or cross-version portability
Projection parent checksum-manifest authentication on read
Same-identity source payload immutability or transactionality against concurrent filesystem/catalog mutation
Rollback of caller external side effects, bounded caller accumulation before preparation, crash durability after atomic publication
Full repository suite, reduced allocation/RSS, higher throughput or the global <=10% stock-reader speed target

reused_without_new_codec: Existing selected typed DDL and part readers
Existing Wide writer planning/codec/transport/readback budgets and exclusive PartDirectoryPublisher
production.physical_context_note: ClickHouse also recursively composes serializers. Local nested Object callback tapes/coordinate contexts already exist; the remaining top-level stream/mark/framing bridge is not a serializer per wrapper Cartesian product.
